name: Krea
summary: Creative AI suite to generate, edit and enhance images and video.
description: Krea is a creative AI suite that generates, edits and upscales images and videos using many leading models, including real-time generation as you draw. It is aimed at designers who want several models in one interface. A free plan is available, with paid plans adding compute units, faster generation and commercial use.

pricing.label: Freemium
pricing.note: A free plan is available, with paid plans adding compute units, faster generation and commercial use.

howToUse.title: Create an image or a video
howToUse.description: The homepage says to create images and videos with the models it lists, and links Krea Agent.

howToUse.title: Or hand the idea to Krea Agent
howToUse.description: The page says Krea Agent turns an idea into images and videos: it plans, creates, and refines them with you.

howToUse.title: Edit by typing or by drawing
howToUse.description: The page says you can change an image by typing, or render as you draw on a live canvas.

howToUse.title: Add it to ChatGPT if you want
howToUse.description: The homepage offers Get Krea into ChatGPT. It mentions three steps, but those steps are not written out on the page.

features_fr: Suite Creative AI pour générer, éditer et améliorer des images et des vidéos.
Krea est une suite d'IA créative qui génère, édite et met à l'échelle des images et des vidéos à l'aide de nombreux modèles de pointe, y compris la génération en temps réel pendant que tu dessinez.
Il s'adresse aux designers qui souhaitent plusieurs modèles dans une seule interface.
Un forfait gratuit est disponible, avec des forfaits payants ajoutant des unités de calcul, une génération plus rapide et une utilisation commerciale.
